rule: Game clock runs 13 game seconds per real second. Each hour boundary re-rolls the 36 world-map quadrant weathers: a variant is picked with weights 40/20/20/10/10 (variants 2/1/3/0/4) and looked up as climate x 20 + season x 5 + variant in an EXE-derived table. A location's weather is sampled once on entry and then held. Heavy fog is a pure function of the zero-based day (day & 8). A storm is active 18:01 to 06:00: a flash lasts 0.35 s, a bolt 0.20 s, and the next strike comes after 0.35 s plus uniform 0 to 5 s, so flashes never overlap. Rain and snow are three speed tiers each (20/20/20 drops; 20/30/50 flakes). Daylight fog runs 06:15-17:45 and only for overcast or snow. Lamps, music, ambient and storm all read one named-clock file.
keep: One named-clock file (18 times) drives lamps, ambient, music and storms.
Thunder timer with a minimum gap equal to the flash length, so flashes never overlap.
Three speed tiers per particle type for depth.
Sky gradient as a palette index slide over the day, clamped at night.
Heavy fog as a pure function of the day number (no random call).
Weather sampled once on map entry and held, not re-rolled while standing in place.
